# Command

`c.Command` calls the API's Command group. Run a command on target hosts.

## Methods

| Method                                  | Returns                                | Permission        | Description                            |
| --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ----------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| [`Exec(ctx, hostname, input)`](#exec)   | `*Response[Collection[CommandResult]]` | `command:execute` | Run a program with its arguments.      |
| [`Shell(ctx, hostname, input)`](#shell) | `*Response[Collection[CommandResult]]` | `command:shell`   | Run a command line through /bin/sh -c. |

### Exec

```go
func (s *CommandService) Exec(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input CommandExecInput,
) (*Response[Collection[CommandResult]], error)
```

Run a program with its arguments.

Runs the program with its arguments, each one word, with no shell between them:
a ; or a | in an argument is that character. It answers with standard output and
standard error apart, the exit code and the duration. A program that exits
non-zero is a result, not an error. Only the admin role may run it, and the
agent runs it only where agent.command.enabled is true.

It sends `POST /api/node/{hostname}/command/exec`, and needs the permission
`command:execute`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Print a word, `go run command.go exec`:

```go
resp, err := c.Command.Exec(ctx, target, client.CommandExecInput{
	Args:    []string{"hello"},
	Command: "echo",
})
```

A program that exits non-zero, `go run command.go exec-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Command.Exec(ctx, target, client.CommandExecInput{Command: "false"})
```

In a directory, for at most 5 seconds, `go run command.go exec-3`:

```go
resp, err := c.Command.Exec(ctx, target, client.CommandExecInput{
	Command: "true",
	Cwd:     "/tmp",
	Timeout: 5,
})
```

### Shell

```go
func (s *CommandService) Shell(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input CommandShellInput,
) (*Response[Collection[CommandResult]], error)
```

Run a command line through /bin/sh -c.

Runs the command line through /bin/sh -c, so pipes, redirects and variables
work. It answers as exec does. Its permission is command:shell, apart from
exec's command:execute: a token that may run a program may not open a shell.
Only the admin role gets it.

It sends `POST /api/node/{hostname}/command/shell`, and needs the permission
`command:shell`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A pipe, `go run command.go shell`:

```go
resp, err := c.Command.Shell(ctx, target, client.CommandShellInput{Command: "echo hello | tr a-z A-Z"})
```

A command line that exits non-zero, `go run command.go shell-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Command.Shell(ctx, target, client.CommandShellInput{Command: "exit 3"})
```

## Types

The fields of each type are the properties of its schema in the API's spec.

### CommandExecInput

| Field     | Type       | Description                                                       |
| --------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Args`    | `[]string` | Its arguments, each one word, such as -la /tmp.                   |
| `Command` | `string`   | The program, a name on the agent's PATH or a path, such as ls.    |
| `Cwd`     | `string`   | The directory to run it in; the agent's own when empty.           |
| `Timeout` | `int`      | Seconds to let it run before it is stopped, up to 300; 30 when 0. |

### CommandResult

| Field        | Type                  | Description                                                                            |
| ------------ | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Changed`    | `bool`                | Whether the host changed: true, since a command can change anything.                   |
| `DurationMS` | `int64`               | How long it ran, in milliseconds.                                                      |
| `Error`      | `string`              | Error message if the agent failed.                                                     |
| `ExitCode`   | `int`                 | Its exit code.                                                                         |
| `Hostname`   | `string`              | Hostname of the agent that produced this result.                                       |
| `Status`     | `CommandResultStatus` | The status of the operation for this host. It is one of: ok, failed, skipped, timeout. |
| `Stderr`     | `string`              | What it wrote to standard error.                                                       |
| `Stdout`     | `string`              | What it wrote to standard output.                                                      |

### CommandResultStatus

The status of the operation for this host.

A `string`, one of `ok`, `failed`, `skipped`, `timeout`.

### CommandShellInput

| Field     | Type     | Description                                                                |
| --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Command` | `string` | The command line, which /bin/sh -c reads, such as ls -la /tmp \| grep log. |
| `Cwd`     | `string` | The directory to run it in; the agent's own when empty.                    |
| `Timeout` | `int`    | Seconds to let it run before it is stopped, up to 300; 30 when 0.          |
